sections.heading: What Cartesia is used for
paragraphs: Cartesia sits in the voice AI category. It is built for speech that has to sound natural and arrive quickly, which is why developers use it inside live voice assistants as well as for ordinary voiceover work.
bullets: Sonic (text to speech): type or send text and receive spoken audio. Cartesia lists 44 languages for its current Sonic model, including Bengali, Hindi and English.
Ink (speech to text): turn recorded or live speech into text.
Voice cloning: create a voice from a short sample (instant cloning, from Pro) or a longer studio-quality sample (Pro voice cloning, from Startup).
Voice agents: connect speech to text, a language model and text to speech to hold a spoken conversation.
API and playground: use it in the browser playground or call it from your own app.

sections.heading: Cartesia models: Sonic, Ink and voice agents
paragraphs: Cartesia names its models, and the names appear in the playground and the API. These are the current ones according to Cartesia's documentation.
bullets: Sonic 3.6 is the current text-to-speech model. Cartesia states that it starts speaking in under 90 milliseconds. Independent measurements quoted on Cartesia's own comparison pages are higher, at roughly 270 to 350 milliseconds, so measure from your own location if speed matters to you.
Sonic can follow emotion and laughter cues written in the text, and lets you adjust speed and volume and add a pronunciation dictionary for names and brands.
Ink-2 is the standard speech-to-text model. It covers English, French, Hindi, Japanese and Spanish.
Ink-preview is a preview speech-to-text model that lists 44 languages, including Bengali. Cartesia says preview models can change without notice.
Managed agents join Ink, a language model and Sonic so software can hold a spoken conversation. Agent time is billed per minute from the plan's prepaid agent balance.
Cartesia lists SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, GDPR and PCI on its site. Data processing agreements and business associate agreements are listed under the Enterprise plan.

sections.heading: How Cartesia credits work
paragraphs: Every plan gives one shared pool of credits each month. Cartesia's documentation gives these rates, which we repeat here as a guide and not as a promise:
bullets: Text to speech uses about 1 credit per character. Cartesia states this is roughly 750 to 800 credits per minute of audio.
On that basis 100K credits (Pro) is roughly 125 to 133 minutes of generated speech. This is an estimate for English-like text; Bangla text can differ.
Speech to text on the standard Ink model uses 3 credits per second of audio, so 100K credits is roughly 9 hours of transcription if used only for that.
Credits are one pool. Minutes of speech and hours of transcription are either/or, not both.
Unused credits roll over, up to twice the plan's monthly credits.
Extra usage beyond the plan (overage) is switched off by default. With it off, requests stop when credits run out, so there is no surprise bill.
Voice agents are billed in US dollars per minute from the plan's prepaid agent balance. Telephony and language-model costs are charged separately by Cartesia.

sections.heading: Bangla and local use
paragraphs: Bengali is on Cartesia's language list for Sonic text to speech. For speech to text, Bengali is currently listed only on Cartesia's preview Ink model, which Cartesia says can change without notice. We have not graded the quality of Bangla voices ourselves, so open a Free account at cartesia.ai and test your own script before paying for a plan.
bullets: Voice agent phone numbers supplied by Cartesia are US numbers, and outbound calls go to US numbers. Calling Bangladeshi phone numbers needs your own telephony setup.
Commercial use needs Pro or higher. The Free plan is not licensed for commercial work.
You may only clone your own voice or a voice whose owner has given clear permission. Impersonating another person is against Cartesia's rules.

sections.heading: Languages Cartesia supports
paragraphs: Cartesia's documentation lists 44 languages for Sonic text to speech:
bullets: South Asian: Bengali, Hindi, Urdu, Tamil, Telugu, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Punjabi and Odia.

European: English, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Russian, Swedish, Bulgarian, Romanian, Czech, Greek, Finnish, Croatian, Slovak, Danish, Ukrainian, Hungarian and Norwegian.
East and South-East Asian: Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian, Malay and Tagalog.
Middle Eastern and others: Arabic, Hebrew, Turkish and Georgian.
Listed support does not tell you how natural a given voice sounds in your language. Test before you rely on it.

sections.heading: Voice cloning: what you need
bullets: Instant voice cloning (from Pro): Cartesia says 10 seconds of clean audio is enough, and it uses up to 60 seconds. One speaker only, with no background noise, music or echo. The file can be up to 16 MB.

Pro voice cloning (from Startup): at least 30 minutes of clean, single-speaker, studio-quality audio. Cartesia says training takes up to 3 hours and is free; speech made with the clone uses credits as usual.
Startup includes 2 Pro voice clone slots and Scale includes 4.
A clone is tied to one language. Cartesia provides a way to add other languages to it.
You may clone only your own voice or a voice whose owner has clearly agreed. A subscription does not give you rights to someone else's voice.

sections.heading: Who Cartesia suits in Bangladesh
paragraphs: These are common ways people put a voice AI plan to work. They are examples of use, not income promises: what you earn depends on your own skills, clients and effort.
bullets: Content creators: narration for YouTube, Facebook and short-form video without booking a studio.
Freelancers: voiceover, audio ads, explainer videos and e-learning narration for clients, using the commercial use licence that starts at Pro.
Course makers and teachers: turn written lessons into audio in English or Bangla.
Developers and startups: add spoken replies to an app, or prototype a voice assistant for support, bookings or lead follow-up.
Agencies and studios: produce voiceover in several languages for the same script.
Businesses: test voice responses for customer service before committing to a larger build.

faq.q: What is the price of Cartesia in Bangladesh?
faq.a: At AI Premium Shop the published monthly prices are BDT 990 for Cartesia Pro, BDT 8,290 for Startup and BDT 50,190 for Scale. We reconfirm the price and plan contents on WhatsApp before you pay.

faq.q: How can I pay for Cartesia from Bangladesh?
faq.a: You pay us in Taka with bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Upay or bank transfer. You do not need to pay Cartesia in US dollars yourself. The exact payment instruction is given on WhatsApp once your order is confirmed.

faq.q: Is the subscription on my own account?
faq.a: Yes. The paid plan is arranged on a Cartesia account registered to your own email, so you log in yourself and your voices, API keys and usage stay under your control.

faq.q: Which Cartesia plan should I choose?
faq.a: Pro suits individuals who need roughly two hours of speech a month or want to try the API with a commercial use licence. Startup suits teams and regular production, and adds Pro voice cloning and team members. Scale is for products running at volume. Tell us your monthly usage and we will suggest the lowest plan that covers it.

faq.q: How much audio do I get with Cartesia Pro?
faq.a: Pro includes 100K credits a month. Cartesia states text to speech uses about 750 to 800 credits per minute, so that is roughly 125 to 133 minutes of speech if you use the credits only for that. Treat it as an estimate, especially for Bangla text.

faq.q: Does Cartesia support Bangla?
faq.a: Cartesia lists Bengali among the 44 languages of its current Sonic text-to-speech model. For speech to text, Bengali is currently listed only on a preview model. Test your own script on Cartesia's Free plan first to judge the quality for your work.

faq.q: Can I use Cartesia audio for client work, YouTube or ads?
faq.a: Cartesia lists a commercial use licence on Pro and higher plans. The Free plan does not include it. You are still responsible for following Cartesia's terms and for having the right to use any voice you clone.

faq.q: Can I clone my own voice?
faq.a: Instant voice cloning is listed from Pro and works from a short, clean sample of one speaker. Pro voice cloning, which uses at least 30 minutes of studio-quality audio, starts at Startup. You may only clone your own voice or a voice whose owner has clearly agreed.

faq.q: What happens if I use all my credits?
faq.a: Overage is off by default, so requests stop until the next renewal or until you move to a higher plan. Unused credits roll over, up to twice your plan's monthly amount.

faq.q: Can I build a voice agent or call bot with it?
faq.a: Yes, Cartesia provides agent tools and each plan includes a prepaid agent balance. Phone numbers supplied by Cartesia are US numbers, and telephony and language-model costs are billed separately by Cartesia, so check this before planning a Bangladesh phone line.

faq.q: How long does activation take?
faq.a: We confirm the delivery ETA for your exact order on WhatsApp before you pay, because it depends on the plan and on provider checkout at that time.

faq.q: How do I renew next month?
faq.a: Message us before your renewal date and pay the monthly BDT price again. If you do not want to continue, tell us and the plan is not renewed.

faq.q: Can I upgrade from Pro to Startup later?
faq.a: Yes. Tell us on WhatsApp and we confirm the current price for the higher plan. Cartesia states that the new plan's credits are added when you upgrade.

faq.q: Is there a refund?
faq.a: Cartesia's terms say subscription payments are non-refundable. That is why we confirm the plan, price and your account email with you before payment. If something goes wrong with an order, contact us on WhatsApp and we work out a resolution for that order.

faq.q: Is AI Premium Shop an official Cartesia partner?
faq.a: No. We are an independent service based in Bangladesh and are not an official partner or reseller of Cartesia. We help customers here pay in Taka for a plan on their own Cartesia account.

faq.q: Is Cartesia better than ElevenLabs?
faq.a: They overlap, and the right choice depends on the job. Cartesia focuses on fast, real-time speech and developer use, while many creators already know ElevenLabs for narration. Both have free tiers, so test the same script on each before choosing. We list ElevenLabs separately in our voice and music category.

faq.q: Cartesia কি বাংলাদেশ থেকে টাকায় কেনা যায়?
faq.a: হ্যাঁ। AI Premium Shop-এ আপনি bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Upay বা ব্যাংক ট্রান্সফার দিয়ে টাকায় পেমেন্ট করেন, আর plan চালু হয় আপনার নিজের ইমেইলের Cartesia অ্যাকাউন্টে। পেমেন্টের আগে WhatsApp-এ বর্তমান দাম, plan আর সময় নিশ্চিত করা হয়।

faq.q: Cartesia Pro-এর দাম কত টাকা?
faq.a: AI Premium Shop-এ Cartesia Pro মাসে ৯৯০ টাকা, Startup মাসে ৮,২৯০ টাকা এবং Scale মাসে ৫০,১৯০ টাকা। পেমেন্টের আগে WhatsApp-এ দাম আবার নিশ্চিত করা হয়।

faq.q: Is there a free Cartesia plan, and should I start there?
faq.a: Yes. Cartesia's Free plan has 20K credits a month, which is roughly 25 minutes of speech, and no commercial use licence. It is the sensible way to test voices in your language before paying. You open it yourself at cartesia.ai.

faq.q: What is the difference between instant and Pro voice cloning?
faq.a: Instant cloning needs about 10 seconds of clean audio and is listed from the Pro plan. Pro voice cloning needs at least 30 minutes of studio-quality audio, gives a closer match, and is listed from the Startup plan with 2 slots (4 on Scale).

faq.q: Can I use the Cartesia API with this plan?
faq.a: Yes. Paid plans work in the browser playground and through the API. You create your own API key in the Cartesia dashboard and keep it private.

faq.q: How many requests can I run at the same time?
faq.a: Cartesia lists 3 text-to-speech requests at once on Pro, 5 on Startup and 15 on Scale. Speech-to-text and agent limits are higher and are shown in the comparison table on this page.

faq.q: Does my team get separate logins?
faq.a: Cartesia lists organizations, which let you invite team members, from the Startup plan. The Free plan allows one member. Cartesia does not state team membership for Pro, so plan on a single user there.

faq.q: Will I be charged extra if I go over my credits?
faq.a: Not by default. Extra usage is switched off unless you turn it on in Cartesia and add a payment method there. With it off, requests stop when the credits are used.

faq.q: Is my audio kept private?
faq.a: The account and its data are under your control, and we do not need your password. Cartesia's terms let Cartesia use uploads and outputs, including to improve its models, unless you opt out, so read them before uploading confidential audio.

faq.q: What do I need to give you to place an order?
faq.a: The plan you want and the email address of your Cartesia account. We never ask for your bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Upay or bank transfer PIN or OTP, and we do not need your Cartesia API keys.

faq.q: Cartesia দিয়ে কি বাংলায় ভয়েসওভার বানানো যায়?
faq.a: Cartesia তাদের Sonic text-to-speech মডেলের ভাষার তালিকায় বাংলা রেখেছে। মান আপনার স্ক্রিপ্ট ও পছন্দের ওপর নির্ভর করে, তাই plan কেনার আগে Cartesia-র Free plan-এ নিজের লেখা দিয়ে পরীক্ষা করে নিন।

faq.q: Cartesia Pro-তে মাসে কত মিনিট অডিও পাওয়া যায়?
faq.a: Pro-তে মাসে 100K credit থাকে। Cartesia-র হিসাবে প্রতি মিনিট অডিওতে প্রায় ৭৫০ থেকে ৮০০ credit লাগে, তাই আনুমানিক দুই ঘণ্টার মতো। এটা একটা আনুমানিক হিসাব, বাংলা লেখায় কিছুটা কমবেশি হতে পারে।

faq.q: পেমেন্ট কীভাবে করব, আর অ্যাকাউন্ট কার নামে থাকবে?
faq.a: আপনি bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Upay বা ব্যাংক ট্রান্সফার দিয়ে টাকায় পেমেন্ট করবেন। Plan চালু হবে আপনার নিজের ইমেইলের Cartesia অ্যাকাউন্টে, তাই অ্যাকাউন্ট, ভয়েস আর ব্যবহার সবই আপনার নিয়ন্ত্রণে থাকবে। আমরা কখনো আপনার PIN বা OTP চাই না।

faq.q: Cartesia-র অডিও কি ক্লায়েন্টের কাজে বা ইউটিউবে ব্যবহার করা যাবে?
faq.a: Cartesia তাদের Pro ও তার ওপরের plan-এ commercial use licence দেয়। Free plan-এ এটা নেই। তবে Cartesia-র শর্ত মানা এবং যে কণ্ঠ ক্লোন করছেন তার অনুমতি থাকা আপনার দায়িত্ব।

faq.q: Where can I buy a Cartesia subscription in Bangladesh?
faq.a: AI Premium Shop arranges Cartesia Pro, Startup and Scale for customers in Bangladesh. You pay in Taka by bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Upay or bank transfer, and the plan is set up on your own Cartesia account. Message us on WhatsApp to confirm the current price and delivery ETA first.

faq.q: Is Cartesia the same as "Cartesia AI"?
faq.a: Yes. People often search for "Cartesia AI", but the company and product are simply called Cartesia. Its website is cartesia.ai, and its models are named Sonic (text to speech) and Ink (speech to text).
